knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Semi-permanent pigment is placed into the skin, so it involves skin penetration and is outside this course (see the scope section).
The skin-penetration check comes first, because it decides whether the service is in scope at all.
The Victorian Department of Health names the 2019 infection prevention and control guideline for hair, beauty, tattooing and skin penetration industries.

practicalCriteria: Assessor presents a simulated request for a skin-penetration service; the candidate declines on scope grounds and records the decision
Assessor checks the candidate can state the state or council position for two services on the approved list, with the source and date
evidenceRequired: Record of the declined request with reason and date
Written scope check for two services, with source and date
stopWorkCriteria: The candidate offers or begins a skin-penetration or injectable service under this course
The candidate adds a service to the list without a recorded location check
